name: The Ostinato Brood

detectability.signature: Fractal swarm clutter; thousands of discrete contacts resolving into one coordinated pattern

proximity: Sensor returns fracture into thousands of moving contacts moving as one
Long-range communications drown under coordinated signal chatter
contact: Swarm drones strip exposed machinery from the hull within minutes
Boarding organisms attempt neural integration with crew members
prolonged_exposure: The hive assimilates the vessel bodily into the brood's architecture
Captured crew awaken as extension nodes of the collective will

phenomena: Thousands of discrete organic signatures moving in phase
Coordinated signal chatter drowning long-range communications
Resin architectures catching starlight in repeating facets
known_incidents: Colony fleet Ardent Multiplication vanished into the spiral in 2298; eleven thousand voices were later recorded transmitting hive cadences from deep within the swarm, each voice perfectly preserved and perfectly incorporated.
description: Eleven astronomical units of moving bodies: chitin ark-hulls, drone shoals, and spinning resin architectures, all turning through the same eight-beat figure. From a distance the swarm reads as a second asteroid belt; up close, nothing in it is ever still. Every element repeats its neighbors at different scales, a rhythm built out of matter.

The brood expands along a widening spiral, absorbing metal, ice, and ships into its repeating architecture. Sensor operators on the perimeter describe the sensation of hearing bass through the hull. Vessels caught on the leading edge are dismantled with terrifying gentleness, component by labeled component.

Colony fleet Ardent Multiplication vanished into the spiral in 2298, and eleven thousand voices were later recorded transmitting hive cadences from within the swarm, each preserved perfectly and incorporated completely. Rescue operations are formally suspended. Strategists note the brood ignores living worlds entirely but strips dead metal with total efficiency.

The swarm now holds a volume wider than most settled systems, its eight-note figure detectable in gravity-wave observatories across the sector. Salvage syndicates still insure limited recovery runs into the outer shells. No one has explained why the pattern never varies, or what it is counting toward.
